blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Budget watchdog People’s Budget Coalition (PBC) on Thursday said Congress’ spending plan should have faced greater scrutiny after budget discussions for the legislature were terminated without any questions on the floor. “Scrutiny should be even higher when Congress is deliberating its own budget,” PBC co-coordinator Gybel Agregado told the Inquirer in a text message. She said civil society groups were blindsided when the House of Representatives suddenly rescheduled Congress’ budget debate, preventing them from attending the proceedings. The legislature’s spending plan talks had originally been set for Sept. 24. “With this urgent change in schedule for a major […]...
